chunks: When you go to the grave that is in Al-Baqi', make it in front of you.

Then you should say: Peace be upon you, O Imams of Guidance; Peace be upon you, People of Piety; Peace be upon you, Proofs upon the people of the world; Peace be upon you, Those who uphold justice among the creation; Peace be upon you, People of the Elite; Peace be upon you, People of the Inner Circle.

I testify that you have delivered (the Message) and preached, and were patient in the cause of Allah, and you were belied and treated poorly, yet you forgave. And I testify that you are the Righteous, Guided Imams, and that obedience to you is obligatory, and your word is the truth, and that you called but were not answered, and ordered but were not obeyed.

And that you are the pillars of the Religion and the cornerstones of the earth, and you have not ceased to be in the Eye of Allah, who reproduces you in the loins of every purified one and transfers you into the wombs of the purified ones. The ignorance of the ignorant did not soil you, nor did the trials of whimsical desires share in you. You are good, and goodly was your origin.

The Judge of the Religion has favored us with you, so He made you to be in the houses which Allah permitted to be elevated and His Name to be mentioned therein. He made our sending of blessings upon you a mercy for us and an expiation for our sins. When He chose you for us, He purified our creation by what He favored us with from your Wilayah, and we were named at His presence by your merit, acknowledging with our ratification.

Be aware! And this is the station of one who transgressed and erred and took shelter, and acknowledged what he committed, and hoped for deliverance by his station, and that the Deliverer would rescue him from destruction through you.
So be intercessors for me, for I have come as a delegate to you when the people of the world turned away from you, and took the Signs of Allah as mockery, and were arrogant about them.

O He who is Everlasting without forgetting, and Permanent without vanity, and Encompassing all things. To You is the Favor with what You made me concordant with and introduced me to, from what You entrusted me with. When Your servants turned away from them, were ignorant of their recognition, took their rights lightly, and inclined to others besides them.

Thus is the Favor from You upon me along with a people You specialized with what You specialized me with. So for You is the Praise, when I am mentioned and recorded at Your presence in this station of mine.
And do not deprive me of what I hoped for, nor disappoint me in what I supplicated for. And supplicate for yourself with whatever you like.

key_terms.الْبَقِيعِ: Al-Baqi', a famous cemetery in Medina

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication recited when visiting the graves in Al-Baqi?
ai.summary: This supplication, found in *Al-Kafi*, serves as a comprehensive theological declaration of the Imams' status as *Hujjah* (proofs) and pillars of the faith, emphasizing their purity from *Jahiliyyah* and their role as intercessors. It contextualizes the visitation not merely as mourning but as an affirmation of *Wilayah* and a plea for salvation through their mediation, reflecting the Shia doctrine of the Imams' enduring spiritual presence. The text highlights the contrast between the Imams' steadfastness and the world's neglect of their rights, reinforcing the concept of *Shafa'ah* (intercession) on the Day of Judgment.

en.hubeali: – (From the narrator of the previous Hadith) When you go to the graves, which are at Al-Baqie, so make it to be in front of you.

Then you should be saying, ‘The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O Imams<sup>asws</sup> of the Guidance! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup> the people of piety! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup> the Proofs upon the people of the world! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, the founders of the justice among the created beings! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O elite people! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, the people of excellency!

I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> have delivered (the Message), and preached, and were patient regarding the Being of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and you<sup>asws</sup> were belied, and they (people) poured grief upon you<sup>asws</sup>, but you<sup>asws</sup> forgave them. And, I testify that obedience to you<sup>asws</sup> and the righteous Imams<sup>asws</sup> (from you<sup>asws</sup>) the Guides is an Obligation and that your<sup>asws</sup> words are the Truth. And you<sup>asws</sup> called but you<sup>asws</sup> were not answered, and you<sup>asws</sup> ordered but you<sup>asws</sup> were not obeyed.

And you<sup>asws</sup> are the foundations of the Religion, and cornerstones of the earth, and never ceased to be in the Eye (Consideration) of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Reproducing you<sup>asws</sup> in the loins of every Purified one, and Transferring you<sup>asws</sup> into the Purified laps, the ignorance of the ignorant ones not soiling you<sup>asws</sup>, nor being affected by the strife of the whimsical desires. You<sup>asws</sup> are good and goodly was your<sup>asws</sup> coming to the world.

The Creator of the Religion Favoured upon us, so He<sup>azwj</sup> Made you<sup>asws</sup> to be in the houses which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Permitted to be Elevated and His<sup>azwj</sup> Name to be mentioned therein, and Made our sending of the Blessings upon you<sup>saww</sup> to be a Mercy upon you, and an expiation for our sins and Chose you<sup>asws</sup> for us, and Made good our births due to what He<sup>azwj</sup> Favoured with upon us from your Wilayah, and we became named by your<sup>asws</sup> merits, acknowledging with our ratifications.

Be aware! And this place, the one who transgresses, and errs, and takes shelter, and acknowledges with what crimes he had committed, and hopes of being finished from it, and that he be Delivered through you<sup>asws</sup> from the destruction and the doom.

Therefore, become intercessors for me, for I am a delegate to you<sup>asws</sup> when the people of the world turned away from you<sup>asws</sup>, and they took the Signs of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> as a mockery, and were arrogant about it.

O the One<sup>azwj</sup> Who Stands without forgetting, and Eternal without any vanity, and Encompasses everything. For You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Favour with what You<sup>azwj</sup> Made me to be concordant with, and Introduced me to what You<sup>azwj</sup> Entrusted me upon, when Your<sup>azwj</sup> servants shut-off from them, and were ignorant of recognising them<sup>asws</sup>, and took their<sup>asws</sup> rights lightly, and inclined to others besides them<sup>asws</sup>.

Thus is the Favour from You<sup>azwj</sup> upon me along with a people You<sup>azwj</sup> have Specialised with what You<sup>azwj</sup> Specialised me with. So, for You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Praise, when I am mentioned in Your<sup>azwj</sup> Presence, Recorded, and do not Prohibit from me what I hope for, nor Disappoint me with regards to what I supplicate to You<sup>azwj</sup> for myself’ – and supplicate for yourself with whatever you so like to’.
en.sarwar: 1. The following is narrated in a mawquf and mursal manner who has narrated the following: (It seems as if it is part of Hadith 5 of previous Chapter narrated from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar). “When you go to the grave in al-Baqi‘ keep it in front of you

and say, ‘(I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are ‘Alayhim al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments), O leaders of (divine) guidance. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are ‘Alayhim al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments), O people of piety. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are ‘Alayhim al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments), O people who possess divine authority over the people of the world. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are ‘Alayhim al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments) O executors of justice among people in the world. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are ‘Alayhim al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments) O chosen ones. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are ‘Alayhim al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments) O the ones with whom cherished conversation is worthwhile.

I testify that you have preached (the divine message) and provided good advice, exercised patience for the cause of Allah, that you were rejected and that certain people treated you in wicked manners but you forgave. I testify that you are intelligent leaders, the well-guiding ones. Obedience to you is obligatory and your words speak the truth. I testify that you called (people to Allah) but you did not receive proper response, gave commands but were not obeyed.

I testify that you are the pillars of religion and the cornerstones of earth. You continue to remain before the eyes (special attention) of Allah. He has kept you as offspring of clean generations and transferred you to clean wombs. The filth of total ignorance or the mischief of evil desires could not affect you. You are of noble birth as well as the noble place of growth.

The Creator of religion and justice has done a great favor to us through you. He thus has placed you in such homes, which Allah wants to be made to stand high wherein His name is spoken of. He has made our asking Him to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause), a blessing for us and expiations for our sins; He has chosen you for us and has cleansed our creation through His favor of making you our guardians with divine authority. We were marked before Him to receive favors from you and that we affirm and acknowledge your divine authority.

This is the place of one who has transgressed, slipped and shown his destitution and has confessed to his sins. He hopes in his place to be relieved and saved through you from destruction and condemnation.
Be my intercessors, I have come to you when people of the world have turned away from you, have taken the signs of Allah in ridicule and have treated them with arrogance.

O the One, who guards without making any mistakes, lives forever but never is playful and has encompassed all things, it is because of Your generosity that You have granted me this opportunity. (You have) introduced to me (my ’A’immah) what You have entrusted me with, when Your servants have kept away from them, lived in ignorance of knowing their high position, treated their rights as insignificant and inclined toward others.

(What you have done for me) is because of Your generosity to me and to certain people whom You have given special attention. All praise belongs to You and thanks for the fact that You have kept me in this position, mentioned and listed me before You.
Do not deprive me in what I hope for and do not fail me in my prayers.’ Pray for yourself and for whatever matter you like.”
